content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only “item 2239” without a transaction dataset or a trained recommendation model. If you provide the purchase history data or a mapping of item co-occurrences, I can compute the top 10 item IDs.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 2239. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
